change_log.value: Implement FastAPI middleware to enforce rate limits using the tracking mechanism. Evaluate request keys (IP/session), query counters, and reject requests exceeding thresholds with HTTP 429 and Retry-After headers.

change_log.value: Implement counter storage (in-memory or MongoDB) with TTL-based expiration, atomic increment operations, and efficient lookup keyed by IP/session to support rate limiting enforcement.
